# New Lines Magazine

> > New Lines Magazine provides in-depth journalism, essays, and analysis on the Middle East, geopolitics, and global conflicts, with particular focus on Turkey, Syria, Lebanon, Russia, and regional transformations.

New Lines Magazine publishes investigative reportage, cultural criticism, and long-form essays exploring conflicts, intelligence operations, political movements, and cultural identity across the Middle East, Eastern Europe, and beyond. The magazine features field reporting from conflict zones, historical analysis, and first-person narratives that challenge conventional Western perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Middle East politics and conflicts
- Syria and Lebanon
- Turkey and Turkish intelligence (MİT)
- Russia and Vladimir Putin
- Israeli-Palestinian relations
- Taliban and Afghanistan
- Intelligence and security services
- Regional geopolitics and sectarianism
- Cultural identity and migration
- Historical analysis of religious communities
- Film and media criticism
- Mental health in non-Western contexts
- China's Muslim communities
- Brexit and Ireland
- American foreign policy

## Investigative Reportage

- [Exclusive: Berlin Murder Suspect's New Ties to Russian Security Services](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/exclusive-berlin-murder-suspects-new-ties-to-russian-security-services): Investigation into Krasikov's Russian intelligence links in Berlin killing
- [After America: Inside the Taliban's New Emirate](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/after-america-inside-the-talibans-new-emirate): Field reportage from Taliban-controlled Helmand after US withdrawal
- [As Murder Plagues Palestinian Towns in Israel, the Killers Are Rarely Caught](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/as-murder-plagues-palestinian-towns-in-israel-the-killers-are-rarely-caught): Reportage on unsolved murders and gun violence in Arab-Israeli communities
- [Is Putin Sick – Or Are We Meant to Think He Is?](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/is-putin-sick-or-are-we-meant-to-think-he-is): Investigation into Putin health rumors and potential Kremlin disinformation
- [In Treatment: Therapy in the Middle East Needs a Non-Western Approach](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/in-treatment-therapy-in-the-middle-east-needs-a-non-western-approach): Reportage on culturally-adapted mental health therapy in Arab world
- [Is Israel's 'Government of Change' More of the Same?](https://newlinesmag.com/reportage/is-israels-government-of-change-more-of-the-same): Reportage on Bennett coalition's West Bank settlement policies continuity

## Historical and Cultural Essays

- [The Riddle of the Sinai Sphinx](https://newlinesmag.com/essays/the-riddle-of-the-sinai-sphinx): Essay on alphabet invention through Sinai turquoise miners and hieroglyphs
- [The Rich History of China's Islam](https://newlinesmag.com/essays/the-rich-history-of-chinas-islam): Essay on Sino-Muslim history, Hui and Uyghur communities, and sinicization
- [Maronite Christians and the Third Way](https://newlinesmag.com/essays/maronite-christians-and-the-third-way): Historical essay on Maronite Christians' sectarian conflicts in Lebanon
- [Roger Williams, the Gentle Zealot Who Refused America's 'City on a Hill'](https://newlinesmag.com/essays/roger-williams-the-gentle-zealot-who-refused-americas-city-on-a-hill): Essay on Roger Williams' legacy in church-state separation in America
- [Between Muhammad Ali and Me](https://newlinesmag.com/essays/between-muhammad-ali-and-me): Personal essay linking Muhammad Ali to British-Bengali identity in 1990s

## Middle East Politics and Analysis

- [Turkey's New Spy Mission](https://newlinesmag.com/argument/turkeys-new-spy-mission-teskilat): Analysis of Turkey's MİT intelligence ops under Erdoğan via Teşkilat TV series
- [The Death of the Palestinian Cause Has Been Greatly Exaggerated](https://newlinesmag.com/argument/the-death-of-the-palestinian-cause-has-been-greatly-exaggerated): Argument on Palestinian cause relevance amid UAE-Israel normalization
- [What If Putin's Bluffing?](https://newlinesmag.com/argument/what-if-putins-bluffing): Analysis questioning imminent Russia-Ukraine invasion predictions in 2022
- [The Lasting Pain of Ireland's Partition](https://newlinesmag.com/argument/the-lasting-pain-of-irelands-partition): Analysis of Ireland partition legacy and Brexit impact on Northern Ireland

## Podcasts and Multimedia

- [Afghanistan: After the Taliban Takeover](https://newlinesmag.com/podcast/afghanistan-after-the-taliban-takeover): Podcast on Afghanistan post-Taliban takeover and women's education impacts

## Cultural Criticism and Reviews

- ['Warsha': A Bird's-Eye View of Beirut](https://newlinesmag.com/review/warsha-a-bird-eye-view-of-beirut): Film review of Warsha exploring Syrian migrant worker's life in Beirut
- [For Most of Turkey's History, Liberalism Has Been More Illusory Than Real](https://newlinesmag.com/review/for-most-of-turkeys-history-liberalism-has-been-more-illusory-than-real): Book review examining Turkish liberalism from Ottoman era to present

## Optional

- [Christmas in Britain: Candles for All, God for Some](https://newlinesmag.com/first-person/christmas-in-britain-candles-for-all-god-for-some): First-person reflection on Christmas traditions in York, England
- [A Country with a Conscience](https://newlinesmag.com/first-person/a-country-with-a-conscience): Personal essay on American foreign policy values and Syria withdrawal
